name: Outside Counsel Spend
note: A DPR-aware canvas burn-up whose forecast is recomputed for any as-of month: the trailing three-month run rate against plan is applied to the remaining phased budget, and an 80% band widens with the square root of accumulated monthly variance; drag the as-of slider back and the real months after it are drawn beside the forecast that would have been made. KPIs, firm bullets, the sortable FLIP table and the invoice queue all read the same ledger; set --dlo-spend-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Realisation River
note: A hand-built Sankey where each leak (pre-bill write-off, discounts, credit notes, unpaid) is a constant-width SVG stroke peeling off the bottom of the river on a cubic quarter-bend, so the river narrows exactly by what it loses; changing quarter, practice group or timekeeper lerps every ribbon width and offset in one rAF pass. KPIs, the FLIP-sorted timekeeper table, the weekly utilisation heat map and the write-off list are summed from the same 39 weeks of time entries; set --dlo-hours-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Clause Deviation Review
note: A live word-level LCS diff compares the counterparty clause with whichever playbook rung you pick, weighting risk phrases that come in or go out into a deviation score that animates through a registered integer @property driving both the gauge arc and its counter. Decisions resolve the clause, FLIP the queue to the next one and feed the matrix and log, with J/K, C, A and E as shortcuts; set --dlo-clause-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Renewal Runway
note: A renewal runway where every row is a CSS subgrid sharing the label and timeline columns with the value-at-deadline chart above it, so bars, notice windows and month columns line up by construction. Scrub or play the as-of date and each agreement re-evaluates against its own notice period: windows open, deadlines pulse, and any that slip past unanswered auto-renew with an extension that grows from the term end; set --dlo-renew-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Intake Triage
note: A transparent priority model: five 0–5 factors times adjustable weights, shown as a stacked contribution bar per request, so dragging a weight re-ranks the queue live; rows are subgrid items reordered with the CSS order property (FLIP-animated, bar widths transitioning) and synced to DOM order once motion settles. Assigning from the inline menu updates attorney capacity rings, and resolving feeds the DPR-aware canvas flow chart and SLA ring; set --dlo-intake-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Closing Signature Tracker
note: A deal-closing signature matrix (envelopes by signatory) whose every cell is derived from an event log and the envelope’s routing order, so advancing the clock stamps new signatures in place and releases the next routing step automatically. Rows are subgrids, a column crosshair is pure :has(), the readiness ring animates a registered @property, and the drawer draws each envelope’s routing graph with the live edge marching; set --dlo-esign-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Matter Risk Map
note: A likelihood-by-exposure heat map where each matter is a dot positioned with the CSS translate property, so switching quarter springs every dot to its new cell (staggered by --i) while hand-built SVG arrows trace where each one came from. Likelihood drives the loss-contingency treatment (accrue, disclose, or neither), feeding counting KPIs and a reserve-bridge waterfall that reconciles opening to closing; set --dlo-matter-h to 100dvh in an app.
